pota_all.name: Mammoth Cave National Park
pota_all.notes: The visitor's center is near the middle of the park.

pota_all.name: Reelfoot National Wildlife Refuge
pota_all.notes: This park extends over both the KY and TN State lines. Specify your activation State when submitting logs, as prompted. This is a Refuge with SPECIFIC rules and access DATES! Research carefully!

pota_all.name: Ohio River Islands National Wildlife Refuge
Big South Fork National Recreation Area
Abraham Lincoln Birthplace National Historic Site
pota_all.notes: National Park Service deems this park having two units, the Birthplace unit south of Hodgenville and the Boyhood Home to the northeast.

pota_all.name: Dawkins Line Rail Trail State Park
Fishtrap Lake Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Although owned by US Army Corps of Engineers since 2016, Fishtrap Lake became a Kentucky State Park in 2003 until its transfer of ownership, therefore it shall remain part of the POTA system.

pota_all.name: Levi Jackson Wilderness Road State Park
pota_all.notes: This is a former State park that became a city park. When parks are "demoted" like this, they may remain a POTA park, as long as they were a POTA park when they were a State Park.

pota_all.name: My Old Kentucky Home State Park
Taylorsville Lake State Park
pota_all.notes: Park is open all year. Campground is normally closed mid November thru mid March each year.

pota_all.name: Blue Licks Battlefield State Park
pota_all.notes: Setup can be lower parking lot along River Road, or parking area on pool road, or opposite side of US-68 on Heritage Trail. Please DO NOT setup on the Battlefield area.

pota_all.name: General Butler State Park

pota_all.notes: The above coordinates are to the State Resort Park lodge, but if lodge area creates too much noise, the following coordinates are to a pull-off along resort park roadway 36.912554,-85.049013

pota_all.name: Big Bone Lick State Historic Site
Breaks Interstate State Park
pota_all.notes: This is one of very few interstate parks in the US. It has been examined and researched by POTA so it belongs. Enjoy.

pota_all.notes: Very important to check the website above to see what days and times they are open. Park administration are accommodating but do prefer no parking in front of Church.

pota_all.notes: Check park hours, gates do close.

Fort Heiman National Battlefield

pota_all.name: Trail of Tears National Historic Trail
pota_all.notes: This is a Trail park, and may intersect other Trails, and/or pass through public, State and/or National parks. Research the park Trail map as well as Google Earth to locate an activating area that is within 100 feet of the trail AND on public lands.

pota_all.name: Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area
Ballard Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Because some roadways are prone to flood, the above coordinates are to a safe parking area. However, if river waters are not up, the following coordinates are to an area along the river way 37.137075,-89.089046

pota_all.name: Beechy Creek Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Cr-1238(Baucum LN) is a dead end road with no turn around, park and walk into park.

pota_all.name: Boatwright Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Entire area is prone to flooding, the above coordinates are to a preferred parking area if river waters are up. If the river is at normal stage however, the following coordinates are to a point along the river way 37.073300,-89.151259

West Kentucky Wildlife Management Area

pota_all.name: Winford Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Park boundary begins after crossing railroad tracks. Entrance road travels down a slight hill and makes a left, at that point in the park.

pota_all.name: Daniel Boone National Forest
pota_all.notes: Large forest, many locations and tracts with varied attractions.

pota_all.name: Lewis and Clark National Historic Trail
pota_all.notes: This is a Trail park, and may intersect other Trails, and/or pass through public, State and/or National parks. Research the park Trail map as well as Google Earth to locate an activating area that is within 100 feet of the trail AND on public lands.

pota_all.name: Isaac Shelby Cemetery State Historic Site
Green River State Forest
pota_all.notes: Small parking lot, may be busy or full during hunting season

pota_all.name: Marrowbone State Forest
pota_all.notes: Its reported that the main parking lot is best spot to park, but if you can get service at the top of Gordon Branch Rd there is a gate on the right side (which not supposed to block) you can get cell service and you're on top of a ridge.

pota_all.name: Metropolis Lake State Nature Preserve
pota_all.notes: Small parking area.

pota_all.name: Sinking Creek State Natural Area
pota_all.notes: Open to the public via the Sheltowee Trace trail.

pota_all.name: Otter Creek State Recreation Area
pota_all.notes:
PARKING PERMIT REQUIRED! You will scan a QR code/text a number to get a digital pass. There are signs at park entrance with instructions.
2-fer w/US-4572 is ONLY within 100 ft of the Ohio River near the boat ramp.

pota_all.name: Decker Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Newly created park. Reportedly has one parking lot, but observe/respect posted property and private property signage in vicinity.

pota_all.name: Green River National Wildlife Refuge
pota_all.notes: Roadway occasionally prone to flooding. There are 'Do Not Enter' signs few feet from the roadway, so may be best to activate mobile from shoulder of the road per some maps as the road shoulder is just within the park.

pota_all.name: Wolf Creek National Fish Hatchery
pota_all.notes: Check map as Kendal Recreation Area does not appear within park boundary. High noise floor possible due to nearby power plant.

pota_all.name: Red River National Wild and Scenic River
pota_all.notes: The 19.4-mile segment from KY 746 to the ford below Schoolhouse Branch was designated a National Wild and Scenic River in 1993. See link above for more info and brochure.

pota_all.name: The Green National Wild and Scenic River
pota_all.notes: River mile 181.7 to 207.7. Only three vehicle access spots: Houchin Ferry, Green River Ferry and Dennison Ferry Picnic Area. Park boundaries here: https://kygis.maps.arcgis.com/apps/MapTour/index.html?appid=0a0a423e9a094d62a358dffd208c96fc

pota_all.notes: https://www.fs.usda.gov/recarea/dbnf/recreation/caving/recarea/?recid=72123 River mile 8.5 to 24.4

Bad Branch National Wild and Scenic River

pota_all.notes: This spot is atop the highest spot around with a large enough pull off for several trucks.  Road is well graveled.

pota_all.name: Hoskins Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: The Hoskins WMA is divided into numerous tracts within Harlan and Leslie Counties.

pota_all.name: Jefferson National Forest Wildlife Management Area
Mud Camp Creek Wildlife Management Area
Old Trace Creek Wildlife Management Area
Paul Van Booven Wildlife Management Area
Twin Knobs Campground Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Check the boundaries of the park. Campground is closed during the winter but other areas may be available.

pota_all.name: Zilpo Campground Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Closed during the winter season https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/232370?tab=seasons You may have to camp to visit the campground. Check with management. 2fer with K-4484. This park  is not included as part of US-10158  Pioneer Weapons WMA.

pota_all.name: Horse Mill Branch Wildlife Management Area
Little Sextons Creek Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: Access WMA via official parking area on western edge of park. Travel 0.3 mile north on Buncomb Road, take slight right on East Buncomb Rd / Old Island City Rd for 0.4 mile. Do not access via low-clearance car, you have to ford a small, drop-off  creek.

pota_all.name: University of the Cumberlands Wildlife Management Area
pota_all.notes: This WMA is comprised of three tracts of land in Whitley County and one tract in McCreary County in close proximity to route KY 92. There are no internal roads open to the public, travel within the area is by foot traffic only.

pota_all.name: Green River State Natural Area
pota_all.notes: Can go to this web GIS viewer and use fingertips to zoom in/out to view the multiple boundaries. https://opengisdata.ky.gov/datasets/5cd2d316fdba4aefbc66da807de7ab17_0/explore?location=37.342628%2C-85.774584%2C10.56

pota_all.name: Bat Cave State Nature Preserve
pota_all.notes: To prevent disturbance of the bats in hibernation, caves are closed to public from Oct to May. Preserve IS within boundary of Carter Caves State Park. https://fivco.org/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Carter-Caves-State-Resort-Park-Topographic-Trails-Map.pdf

pota_all.name: Cascade Caverns State Nature Preserve
pota_all.notes: Cascade Caverns parking lot not within NP boundary. A pull-off south of parking lot is within NP boundary. NP is within the boundary of Carter Caves SP. https://fivco.org/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Carter-Caves-State-Resort-Park-Topographic-Trails-Map.pdf
